E0.title: Earn the reader's trust
E0.statement: Trust is the product. Every surface either earns it or spends it.

E1.title: Use the closest source
E1.statement: Link agencies, local orgs, datasets, original docs. Commentary second.

E2.title: Label what we know
E2.statement: Reported fact, interpretation, and hypothesis stay distinct on the page.

E3.title: Measure the work
E3.statement: Named user + observable result. Code shipped is not the same as a problem solved.

E4.title: Protect people before data
E4.statement: No sensitive collection because it might be useful later. Human safety sets the limit.

E5.title: Evidence over confidence theater
E5.statement: No universal confidence score. Citations show work; they do not prove truth.

E6.title: Brief first, sources one level deeper
E6.statement: First click teaches the issue; primary sources wait in the drawer.

E7.title: Credentials stay local
E7.statement: Pairing codes and keys never leave the device trust boundary; no hosted proxy of secrets.

E8.title: Bounded action, not doomscroll
E8.statement: One brief can be enough; recall and verify are short loops that stick.

E9.title: Companion is the product's pet
E9.statement: Syn lives inside the reader as presence and gesture — not a separate bot product.

F-catalog.name: Issue brief catalog
F-catalog.acceptance: Every article has stable id, title, visual, ISO reviewed date, exactly 5 slides; each slide has title, kind, sources[]; flagships multi-source; source URLs http(s).

F-reader.name: Mobile evidence reader
F-reader.acceptance: Opening a brief uses a full-viewport stage; .reader-card is the sole vertical scrollport; theme-color darkens while open and restores paper on close; body scroll locked.

F-seminar.name: Multi-source seminar
F-seminar.acceptance: Multi-source slides render lens chips, crosscut (agree/tension/open), escaped quotes, and voice cards; single-source slides are labeled thin, not papered over.

F-verify.name: Micro-verification and correction
F-verify.acceptance: Daily claim rotates deterministically; correction URL targets synergy-tasks verify-evidence template with brief, insights, and length guard under 6000 characters; comment shape is stable.

F-recall.name: Spaced recall loop
F-recall.acceptance: Prompts per brief; grade forgot→1d, hard→×1.3, got→×2.5 (first success 3d); due cards ordered by due date; home due strip for short return visits.

F-companion-pet.name: Syn companion presence and gestures
F-companion-pet.acceptance: Pet supports drag, flick coast with wall bounce, hold, multi-tap, pinch expand/shrink; reduced-motion disables coast; seat stays in bounds; jelly stretch is velocity-linked.

F-companion-local.name: Local companion trust boundary
F-companion-local.acceptance: Loopback-only server; pairing code on privileged routes; vault AES-GCM; listing never returns secrets; /app serves site including companion-physics.js.

F-board.name: Live task board surface
F-board.acceptance: data/board.json built from the public queue; site renders claimable work without secrets.

F-offline-shell.name: Service worker offline shell
F-offline-shell.acceptance: SHELL lists all critical modules including companion-physics.js; VERSION bumps on ship.

F-quality-gate.name: Layered quality orchestration
F-quality-gate.acceptance: npm run gate runs check-trace + unit + property + companion + smoke; mutation thresholds enforced on pure modules; CI quality.yml on main/dev/PR.
